pl-l4d25c7-d1e115.summary: Gives Pope Nicholas on the age of ordinands: the canons decreed that a subdeacon not be ordained before fourteen, a deacon before twenty-five, a priest before thirty; afterward, if worthy, he may be chosen bishop.
claims: Canonical ages are fourteen, twenty-five, and thirty.

pl-l4d25c7-d1e121.summary: Adds Fabian: no one under thirty may be ordained priest, however worthy, since the Lord himself was baptized at thirty and so began to teach.
claims: Priests must be thirty, after Christ's example.

pl-l4d25c7.summary: Gives the canonical ages for ordination: Pope Nicholas, following the canons, requires fourteen years for subdeacons, twenty-five for deacons, thirty for priests, after which a worthy priest may be chosen bishop; Fabian forbids ordaining a priest under thirty, however worthy, since the Lord was baptized and began to teach at thirty.
claims: Subdeacons must be fourteen, deacons twenty-five, priests thirty.
No one under thirty may be ordained priest.
